title: Currency Exchange Deal
scenario: A street exchanger offers a rate far better than official exchange offices.

answers.A: Use a bank, licensed exchange office, or card provider.
answers.B: Hand over your cash because the rate is too good to miss.
answers.C: Count the notes quickly and accept the exchange if the amount looks close.
answers.D: Check the live rate and fees before exchanging a small amount.

explanation: Street exchanges can involve counterfeit notes, hidden fees, or short-changing. A licensed route gives you a clear rate and recourse.
proTip: A bargain rate is not a bargain without a trustworthy counterparty.
